description:

title: Credit Controller
description:
Location: Bristol
Contract: Temporary

Our client is looking for an experienced Credit Controller to join their busy finance team on a temporary basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing customer accounts, reducing outstanding debt and resolving queries efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts
- Chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
- Allocating and reconciling customer payments
- Investigating and resolving account queries
- Maintaining accurate customer records
- Monitoring aged debt and reducing overdue balances
- Liaising with internal teams to resolve billing and account issues
- Supporting month-end reporting and reconciliations

About You
- Previous experience in Credit Control or Accounts Receivable
- Confident communicating with customers by phone and email
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
- Comfortable working to deadlines and targets
- Good Excel and general IT skills
- Experience using finance systems
- Able to work independently and as part of a team

title: Part Time Accounts Administrator
description:
Are you looking for a part-time role in central Bath?

Do you have strong maths and Excel skills, with previous experience working in accounts?

Juice Recruitment is delighted to be searching for a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Part-Time Accounts Administrator to join our client in Bath.

This is a varied role combining general accounts administration with day-to-day office duties. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, updating databases and assisting with stock checks.

We are looking for someone who is confident working with numbers, with strong excel experience, and excellent attention to detail.

DAY TO DAY
- Carrying out bank and account reconciliations.
- Posting transactions and maintaining the cashbook.
- Processing and recording financial information accurately.
- Updating and maintaining company databases and records.
- Assisting with regular stock checks and investigating discrepancies.
- General accounts and administrative duties.
- Maintaining accurate filing and documentation.

WHAT WE'D LOVE TO SEE
- Previous experience in an accounts or administration role.
- Good knowledge of basic bookkeeping and reconciliations.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and other computer systems.
- Strong Maths skills is essential.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Able to work independently and manage their workload.

AND FOR YOU
- 22 days + Bank Holiday's pro rata for 20 hours
- Flexible with working hours over 3 or 5 days.
- Working for a growing business.
- Excellent office environment and amentities.
- Health cash back plan.

Please apply today to be considered for this role!

title: Part time Finance Assistant - 22. 5 hours per week
description:
Are you an experienced Finance Assistant searching for a new opportunity? We are looking for a Part Time Finance Assistant to join their team on a permanent basis. This role offers a great chance to be involved in essential financial processes, supporting the wider business with purchase ledger tasks, reconciliation, and basic account management. You'll be working closely with the finance team, ensuring smooth and accurate handling of transactions, all while maintaining a welcoming and professional approach. The position is office-based in Bath, perfect for someone looking to balance work and personal commitments, with a flexible, part-time schedule.

DAY TO DAY:
- Accounts payable, processing supplier invoices, using ApprovalMax, ensuring all invoices are allocated correctly, preparing invoices for approval
- Maintain the Accounts payable ledger and payment runs
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolving discrepancies, supplier onboarding and data capture
- Accounts receivable to include checking of rents, service charges, credit control, chasing payments, providing reports to Financial Controller
- Maintaining the ledger, allocating receipts, updating tenant accounts,
- Daily bank reconciliations, posting receipts and journals as needed, credit card reconciliations, tenant deposits,
- Providing reports to the team for service charge budgets using Xero, liaising with wider team re all finance queries,
- Assisting in the preparation of month-end, assisting with preparation of year-end
- Maintain an organised digital filing system, support FC with any other duties, support wider team when required

WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE:
- Previous experience as a Finance or Accounts Assistant, ideally in property or similar sector
- Knowledge of purchase ledger processes and financial reconciliations
- Confidence using accounting software, with experience in Xero being highly desirable
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills and a proactive attitude
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

AND FOR YOU:
- Benefits include competitive salary
- Flexible working hours - 5 shorter days or 3 full days
- Central Bath, modern office environment in established team
